name: Sanjou Azusa
source:
A junior who is one year younger. She is especially fond of [url=https://vndb.org/c62812]Rin Hoshina[/url], but her need for attention and frequent physical contact make Rin a little bit uneasy.

[spoiler]She has a 'partial transformation' condition, making her a futanari.[/spoiler]
